NAGAR-201008 INVITATION FOR BIDS (IFB) FOR Temporary Procurement of Non-Torrefied Biomass Pellets for NTPC Ltd, Dadri (Domestic Competitive Bidding) GeM Bid no.: 1.0 NTPC, Dadri invites on-line bids on Single Stage One Envelope basis (from eligible Bidders for aforesaid procurement, as per the scope of work briefly mentioned hereinaf ter, for NTPC, Dadri for a period of 30 days. The price is Rs. 2.32/1000 kcal (excluding GST) or 2.436 Rs/1000 kcal (including GST) 3 400 Kcal. GST shall be paid as per extant rates and will change if the rates of GST are ch anged. Total procurement price shall be Ex factory Price for Non-Torrefied Biomass {Rs. 2.436 R s/1000Kcal or Rs 8282.40 / MT @3400 Kcal as notified by GoI including GST @5%} + 2.0 Salient Technical Features Brief Scope of Work: The scope of work under this package shall include supply, loading, transport, and deli very of Agro Residue based non-torrefied biomass pellets at NTPC Dadri site. Unloading at NTPC site shall be in the scope of NTPC provided pellets are loose filled in the carriage vehicle. Carriage vehicles should be fully covered and waterproof during t

ransportation to prevent the material from rain, sunlight and to prevent dusting. If supplier supplies the material packed in bags, consignment shall not be accepted, or supplier shall unload and unpack the material at his own cost. In such case, any additi onal cost, including demurrage, if any, will be borne by the vendor The minimum use of 50% raw material as stubble /straw/crop residue of rice paddy so urced from Punjab, Haryana or NCR Region only, is mandatory. Pellets supplied shall a dhere to the technical specification given in tender documents. 3.0 MSE benefit is applicable as mentioned in bidding documents (Clause 8.1.1 of ITB) 4.0 BID Security/EMD: All bids must be accompanied by “Bid Security” OR “UDYAM REGI STRATION CERTIFICATE containing code of Biomass pellets” (as applicable) as on bid s ubmission end date. Amount of Bid Security/EMD shall be as follow: S. NO. Such MSE bidders will have to submit vali d UDYAM Registration Certificate (containing code of Biomass) as proof of bei ng MSE on GeM Portal as EMD. In case of other MSE manufacturers without code of Biomass i.e. 38300 & MSE Traders/service/Consortium etc. MSE benefits shall not be extended & will not be consid ered as proof of being MSE for exemption from submission of EMD. Traders, consortium and aggregators etc. are required to submit EMD. Any bid not accompanied by an acceptable bid security/ UDAYM certificate ( co ntaining code of Biomass pellets code 38300) with in the EMD Folder available at GeM portal shall be rejected by the employer as being non-responsive. In c ase, the bid security is submitted through electronic fund transfer (EFT)/ e-BG

through their bank on NeSL’s Digital Document Execution (DDE) platform, bidder shall sub mit the proof of e-payment/eBG as bid security in EMD Folder available at Ge M portal. 5.0 Complete set of Bidding Documents may be downloaded by interested Bidders through GeM Portal. Bidders must use their GeM Seller ID and Password for participation in the te nder. Bidders may also refer to the Seller Help Document for participating in the tender which is available on GeM website https://gem.gov.in/ Note: No hard copy of Bidding Documents shall be issued. Detailed specifications, scope of work and terms & conditions are given in the Bidding Documents, which are available for examination as per the following schedule: SN Particular Remark 1 Issuance of IFB As per GeM 2 IFB/Tender No As per GeM 3 Documents Issue/ start date Immediately after IFB 4 Last date for receipt of Queries from bidders (if an As per GeM y) through GeM portal 5 Bid submission date & time As per GeM 6 Date and time for opening of bid As per GeM 7 Cost of bidding document Free of cost 6. Further in case of bidder fails to submit following documents (but not limit ed to) in required format, the bid shall be liable to be rejected. i. Annexure C: Certificate of Compliance ii. Declaration by Bidder (Annexure-10) to be submitted on bidder letter head along with technical bid. iii. Integrity Pact (Annexure F 10 duly signed by bidder) iv. Complete & valid GST registration certificate reflecting all plant/ manufacturing loc ations (For manufacturer/Consortium manufacturer). Traders shall submit complete & valid GST registration certificate. v. Power of Attorney (if applicable) vi. No Deviation Certificate (Annexure-F5) vii. Annexure-3 Bidder details viii. BOQ with bid quantity. 7. Class-I local suppliers only are eligible to participate in this tender, as defined in the bidding documents/ Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 and its subsequent amendments /revisions issued by DPIIT. The bidders may apprise themselves of the relevant p

rovisions of bidding documents in this regard before submission of their bids. 8. Transfer of Bidding Documents by one intending Bidder to another is not permissible. 9. Issuance of Bidding Documents to any bidder shall not be construed as bidder is considered qualified. Bids shall be submitted online. Bidder’ s presence during the Techno-Commercial Bid opening and Price Bid opening in NTPC premises is not envisaged. 10. IP address functionality is in place at GeM portal. The primary objective of this fe ature is to identify collusion activities between sellers by capturing their IP address es. During the technical evaluation stage, in case of common IP address of a seller with any other seller/Bidder as popped up in a tender by GeM portal, all such bids s hall be liable for rejection 11. NTPC reserves the right to reject any or all bids or cancel/withdraw the Invitation for Bids (IFB) for the subject package without assigning any reason whatsoever a nd in such case no bidder/intending bidder shall have any claim arising out of such action. 12.
